annotations.title: Create an AI Alert pack from a plan

description: Requires an approved AlertForge account connection. OAuth-aware clients should start AlertForge's secure authorization flow and ask the user only to sign in and approve. Setup: https://alertforge.ai/ai-agents#agent-setup. Spends credits. Consumes a plan from plan_alert_pack and creates its alert(s). Requires an active AlertForge subscription (checked at this step, not at planning) -- fails with 'subscription_required' otherwise. Calling this again with the same planId after it already succeeded is safe -- it returns the same pack rather than creating a second one or charging twice. A single failed alert does not fail the whole call -- check each entry's `error` field in the result. Returns immediately, before any alert has rendered -- call get_alert_pack_status afterward to check progress. Timing varies by model, queue, processing route, and provider demand.
name: create_alert_pack
title: Create an AI Alert pack from a plan
